label: Read from Performance Dashboard
info: Reads the last 24 hourly summaries of one signal through the integration API with a read-only service token. See docs/INTEGRATIONS.md.

name: Needs PD_URL, PD_SERVICE_TOKEN (viewer, granted machines only), PD_MACHINE_ID, PD_NODE_KEY
info:
A service token reads only the integration API's GET endpoints for its granted machines. Keep it in Node-RED's environment, not in the flow.

An hour whose average is null is unknown: some sample was not Good or none was recorded. Do not replace it with zero.

name: Build summaries request
Keep unknown hours unknown
